subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Chloro(triphenylphosphine)gold（Au(PPh₃)Cl）？
A. Linear
B. Trigonal planar
C. Square planar
D. Octahedral
explanation: Linear. Covalent count: Au (group 11) 11 e; 1 × PPh₃ (L) 2 e; 1 × Cl (X) 1 e: 14 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Au(I), d¹⁰; d¹⁰ + 4 e from the ligands = 14 e. Linear d¹⁰ Au(I): 14 electrons is normal for gold(I).
